notes.title: Version 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone! How have you been enjoying your time with Bear's Restaurant so far? We've got a pretty tasty update for you today!

So basically, we've received some reports from players and reviewers regarding the game's English translation quality.  

As a small Japanese indie studio, we really appreciate feedback like this, because we want to make sure our loyal English-speaking players are getting the best experience possible.

To that end, we've brought on a professional translator with more than half a decade of industry experience, including acclaimed projects like the highly successful Muv-Luv Series Kickstarter campaign. 

He's been a passionate fan of Odencat's games for years, and will be working closely with us to ensure that our English translations are up to a professional quality standard while also adhering more closely to the spirit of our original vision.

Today, we're pushing a comprehensive text update for Bear's Restaurant that implements thousands of corrections and improvements to things like:

[list]
[*]Incorrect grammar
[*]Improper punctuation/capitalization
[*]Mistranslations
[*]Overall dialogue flow
[*]Inconsistent terminology
[*]Overall stylization and aesthetics
[*]Emotional punch
[/list]
..and much more!

While many of these fixes were minor and won't be too noticeable, we promise it'll make for a much better player experience overall! We highly recommend checking it out, even if you've already played through Bear's Restaurant before!

Here's a little taste for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022205/7eb4c04b8a75f8ccafa1562770f841e6053f8219.jpg[/img]

In addition to all of the text revisions, this update also fixes a few technical and graphical bugs. We will also be updating the Switch and Mobile versions of the game with these new improvements in the near future.

Again, thanks so much for supporting our very first Steam release!
We've got many more games cooking in the oven that we can't wait to share with you!
